t: 狄奥多拉二世皇后恢复了拜占庭帝国东正教会中圣像的崇拜.
te: Empress Theodora II restores the veneration of icons in the Orthodox churches in the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 东正教的凯旋:狄奥多拉二世皇后恢复了拜占庭帝国东正教会中圣像的崇拜.
de: Triumph of Orthodoxy: Empress Theodora II restores the veneration of icons in the Orthodox churches in the Byzantine Empire.

t: 维京人解雇了法国城市南特.
te: The Vikings sack the French city of Nantes.
